title: Add JSONSchema strict mode with improved error messages and OpenAI compatibility
author: Marcus Patel
description: Introduce a strict JSONSchema response_format mode with improved validation errors and OpenAI-compatible error payloads. Motivation: customers using structured output with schema validation saw confusing errors and integrations with the OpenAI-compat layer expected a consistent error shape. This PR adds server-side strict validation that returns rich, stable error objects when responses fail schema checks, normalizes error fields to match the OpenAI compatibility layer, and adds runtime flags for toggling strict enforcement vs best-effort repair. Changes include runtime validation hooks, clearer error codes, docs and SDK surface notes, e2e tests, and migration notes for existing users. See linked Linear cards for rollout and telemetry requirements.

merge_details: Merged by Marcus Patel with squash merge. Commit message consolidated. Rollout gated by feature flag 'response_format.strict_jsonschema' and enabled for internal beta first.
release_notes: Added strict JSONSchema response_format mode with improved validation errors and OpenAI-compatible error payloads. Feature gated behind response_format.strict_jsonschema. See docs/reference/response_format.md for migration steps and telemetry fields.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag in canary environment first, monitor validation error rates and SDK client failures. Telemetry keys: response_format.validation.error_count, response_format.validation.repair_attempts.
impact_assessment: Low risk behind feature flag. Potential customer-facing changes only when flag is enabled; default remains best-effort behavior. Backwards compatibility preserved for existing integrations unless customers opt-in to strict mode.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for validator and mapper; e2e tests cover streaming and non-streaming cases; CI initially flaked on a timing-dependent test which was hardened. All checks green on final run.
rollback_plan: Disable response_format.strict_jsonschema feature flag and revert mapping in openai-compat if needed; hotfix branch prepared in case of urgent customer-impacting regressions.
customer_impact_examples: If strict mode enabled: responses that do not strictly match schema will return structured validation errors rather than best-effort repaired output.
OpenAI-compat clients will receive a stable error shape with 'type', 'message', 'errors' fields to simplify client-side handling.
